title: These are not nearly as good as the originals from a year ago
text: These are not nearly as good as the originals from a year ago. These are not nearly as good as the originals from a year ago. Disappointed. But still better than some candles out there. This company is frustrating because they cheapened their quality(time of burn and scent) - AND, they are constantly “out of candles”. Not talking about Premier Candle Corp unless they are the manufacturer which I don’t believe they are—talking about simply indulgent. BRING BACK THE ORIGINAL DEEP CANDLES with 1 wick and three amazing fragrances that you originally sold at Costco!!! I’d buy excessively!
